description: Make DeepSeek Harness delegation discoverable without loading a skill or custom Codex subagent.

hooks.command: printf '%s\n' "DeepSeek/DSH delegation is available through helpme_dsh. Independent read-only subagents are concurrent sessions in one plugin-managed Host and shared UI at 127.0.0.1:3080. Never run the same session concurrently; write-capable runs are globally serialized. Defaults and controls are self-described by the MCP. Treat 'DeepSeek subagent' as HelpMe DSH, not a Codex custom subagent."
